Name: Visibility of System Status
Signal: Navigation has 7 links but none marks the current page — no "you are here" feedback.
Recommendation: Add aria-current="page" to the active nav link and style it distinctly.

Name: Visibility of System Status
Signal: No live region found, so status updates (saving, loading, results) are announced to nobody.
Recommendation: Add an aria-live="polite" or role="status" region for async feedback.

Name: Match Between System and the Real World
User Control and Freedom
Signal: No link back to the home page was found — a basic escape route is missing.
Recommendation: Link the logo (or a Home link) to the site root.

Name: Consistency and Standards
Signal: A <span> is styled as clickable but has no button/link semantics.
Recommendation: Use a real <button>/<a>, or add role="button" plus tabindex="0" and key handling.

Name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
Signal: No “Skip to content” link — keyboard users must tab through the whole nav on every page.
Recommendation: Add a skip link as the first focusable element, visible on focus.

Name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
Signal: Content-heavy page with no search — expert users have no accelerator to jump straight to what they want.
Recommendation: Provide site search so returning users can bypass navigation.

Name: Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
Signal: 20 distinct font sizes — the type scale is unstructured, so nothing reads as clearly more important.
Recommendation: Adopt a defined type scale of roughly 5–7 steps.

Name: Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
Help and Documentation
Signal: No help, FAQ, support, or contact link found — users who get stuck have nowhere to go.
Recommendation: Add a findable Help/Support link, ideally in the header or footer.

Name: Colour Contrast (WCAG AA)
Signal: 10 element(s) below the WCAG AA contrast minimum (worst: 1.14:1, needs 3.0:1).
Recommendation: Raise contrast to 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (≥24px, or ≥18.66px bold).

Name: Target Size (WCAG)
Signal: 15 target(s) are smaller than 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8 AA).
Recommendation: Enlarge to at least 24×24px; 44×44px is the comfortable touch target.
